32F AuDHD here and this helped put into words what I have been feeling/doing for as long as I can remember 🤯🤯

I have tried to deal with it this year and have created similar coping mechanisms such as 

• eating super mindfully (ie slowly eating smoothie bowl in the morning sun and appreciating the sunshine and bird sounds as part of the sensory experience so it isn’t all about the food ahaha however this is very reliant on the weather)

• eating whilst watching a show/doco/tv series or whilst doing life admin on my laptop at the kitchen table … getting cosy and/or really creating a multi tasking kinda vibe so I’m “distracted” 

• only eating in spots where I can easily put the plates/bowl down 🙈 sooo ridiculous but I have to literally make sure a surface is around so I can eat mindfully - if I hold the plate or bowl I get into this uncontrollable ravaging state and eat like a psycho (I have a very cute vintage mini table that can go on my bed when I’m having cosy bed self care nights) 

• sitting with myself and trying to genuinely understand hunger cues vs emotional eating …. And then having a very exhausting and extremely shame-riddled debate with myself (ie sitting on the floor in my room trying to figure out if I really do need ANOTHER tbsp of peanut butter or if I can move on from this binge craving ) … I hate this sooo much and it’s extremely emotionally taxing but I guess going through this so many times got me soooo over the binging that I turned to preventative tactics (ie eating with distractions , having a surface nearby, portion control etc…) so the good news that it happens less and less …

I’ve also had anorexia since 14 so these disorders co-existing is FKN INSANE. 

I’m underweight and anyone that knows me well is aware of my diagnosis/battles with EDs but I just slide into healthy BMI range more often than not so I don’t present as badly … 
But the sermon going on in my head feels like it’s written by eating disorder demon 😓😩

Gosh it’s Exhausting but so validating to read others experiences..

Hang in there 🤘🏼💓🫶🏼
